title: Existence of the normalized coherent tensor tower comparison
statement: For every scheme W and pair P,Q, the prescribed finite components extend to an isomorphism between the restricted coherent tensor tower and the integral operations tensor tower, with component at op n equal to pullbackTensorTensorTowerLevel n.

source.place: Tags 0941 and 07A4, strict tower comparison from prescribed finite components

proof.text: Let F and G be the two tower functors and let L n be the hom of the prescribed level isomorphism. The adjacent transition square gives the naturality hypothesis of NatTrans.ofOpSequence, producing a natural transformation h:F⟶G. NatIso.ofComponents applied to L n.unop and h.naturality gives the required levelwise isomorphism; the component formula follows from NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app.

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib examples show adjacent transition squares packaged by NatTrans.ofOpSequence and levelwise isomorphisms by NatIso.ofComponents.
Mathlib declaration NatTrans.ofOpSequence has exactly the adjacent-square hypothesis needed here.

mathlib_searches.query: natural isomorphism from adjacent sequence components
mathlib_searches.results: No shorter project-independent constructor than NatIso.ofComponents.

lean.statement:
theorem pullbackTensorTensorTower_exists (W : Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) :
    ∃ e : pullbackTensorRestrictedTower l E W
      ((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u}
        (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology W))
        (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W)).obj
        ((((pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P),
          (((pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))) ≅
      (integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E W).obj (P,Q),
      ∀ n : ℕ, e.app (op n) = pullbackTensorTensorTowerLevel l E W P Q n
